title: CareVoice
description: RED, JVM, pools, business, outbox, RabbitMQ, Redis and logs for documentation-service and alert-service.

panels.title: Replicas running (scrape targets up)
panels.description: Replicas Prometheus can scrape (Docker DNS / Kubernetes endpoints). 2 expected per service in compose.

panels.title: Replicas ready (/readyz 200)
panels.description: Replicas whose /readyz answered mostly 200 in the last minute. Each replica counts as either ready or not ready, never both.

targets.expr: (count by (service_name) (sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="200", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) > (sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="503", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) or sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="200", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) * 0))) or (sum by (service_name) (up{job=~"documentation-service|alert-service", service_name=~"$service"}) * 0)

panels.title: Replicas not ready (/readyz 503)
panels.description: Replicas whose /readyz answered mostly 503 in the last minute: a critical dependency is down or the pod is draining.

targets.expr: (count by (service_name) (sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="503", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) > (sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="200", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) or sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/readyz", http_response_status_code="503", service_name=~"$service"}[1m])) * 0))) or (sum by (service_name) (up{job=~"documentation-service|alert-service", service_name=~"$service"}) * 0)

panels.title: Live replicas (/livez 200)
panels.description: Replicas whose /livez answered 200 in the last 5 minutes. In compose only Uptime Kuma calls /livez (every 30 s); in Kubernetes the kubelet does.

targets.expr: (count by (service_name) (sum by (service_name, service_instance_id) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route="/livez", http_response_status_code="200", service_name=~"$service"}[5m])) > 0)) or (sum by (service_name) (up{job=~"documentation-service|alert-service", service_name=~"$service"}) * 0)

panels.title: /readyz responses per second by replica and status
panels.description: One line per replica and status code. A replica turning 503 is taken out of the load balancer, not restarted.

panels.title: /livez responses per second by replica and status
panels.description: Liveness: process up. A failing /livez makes Kubernetes restart the pod.

panels.title: Replicas (scrape targets)
panels.description: Every replica Prometheus discovered: 1 = up, 0 = down.

panels.title: Requests per second by status class
panels.description: Health and metrics endpoints are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"/livez|/readyz|/metrics", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(authenticate [^)]*\\)(.*)"), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(RateLimit [^)]*\\)(.*)")) / sum by (service_name) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"/livez|/readyz|/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(authenticate [^)]*\\)(.*)"), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(RateLimit [^)]*\\)(.*)"))

panels.title: % of requests under 300 ms (SLO)
panels.description: Exact ratio from Micrometer's 300 ms SLO bucket (the OpenTelemetry default buckets have no 0.3 s boundary). Over the selected time range.

panels.title: p50 latency by service and route
panels.description: Exemplars link to the Tempo trace of a sampled request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"/livez|/readyz|/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(authenticate [^)]*\\)(.*)"), "http_route", "$1$2", "http_route", "(.*)/\\(RateLimit [^)]*\\)(.*)")))
